Name: Man
Dialog: Oh cool! Old records! Lindana. Now that's a blast from the past. Wonder where she is now... Probably singing at retirement homes.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, give me that. (takes the box of records)

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey, you look familiar.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Dad, what are these?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh wow, those are my old black and white detective movies.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you mind if we watch them?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Not at all boys, the projector's inside.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great, come on Ferb.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh I see you like that little doll. Well lets see... that'll cost you, uh, fifty cents?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'll give you a dollar.

Name: Detective/Narrator
Dialog: She rolled into my office like a fog bank. Mysterious. Cold. My instincts told me this dame was nothing but trouble. But trouble's my middle name... Well not really. My middle name is "Trumble"...Sounds a lot like trouble.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, this detective stuff's great.

Name: Detective/Narrator
Dialog: She had something she needed to say. And she spoke with the voice of an angel...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! Where's the box that was in my room?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well dad was taking boxes out to the yard sale...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, Dad, wait! (She arrives at the front yard) Dad, is that the box from my room?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well yes...

Name: Candace
Dialog: I think I put my Mary McGuffin doll in there by mistake. Have you seen her?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I just sold her for a whole dollar. Here, you can have it.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: How about two dollars?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad? What are you doing here? This isn't your weekend.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, yes I-I know, but I have a surprise for you and I just couldn't wait!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (excited) A surprise? Really?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, it's something you've always wanted. Something you've asked for time and time again. In my hand, I hold the key to...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Gasps) My new car!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (holds up Mary McGuffin doll) No, your happiness! Remember how you said if I got you a little Mary McGuffin doll, I'd be the world's greatest dad?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, when I was like, seven.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: At long last I have found one! I have been scouring the Internet and... and garage sales trying to find the discontinued doll.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wow, I can't believe you remembered I wanted this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Remembered?! I never stopped looking!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Really?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I may be an evil scientist, but it doesn't take a degree purchased from the Internet with your ex-wife's money to know how special and important you are to me.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: That's so sweet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I'd better run. I bought a used -inator today at the garage sale, and it's missing one small part.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Really? What does it do?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't know yet, it's missing a part. But whatever it is I'm sure it will be pure evil!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Talking to the doll) Well, at least you're not evil.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Talking like the detective from the film, with his and Ferb's bedroom painted black and white) It was a dull, hot day in Danville, and she swept into the room like a cool, tropical depression. I could tell by the way she walked, she had something on her mind, either that, or she was chafing from the heat.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's going on here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Her voice flowed soft and smooth, like butter on toast.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And why are you talking like that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She was observant, maybe too observant.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why is everything black and white in here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (talking normally) We painted everything like an old detective movie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What about you guys?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Detective makeup.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Detectives? Perfect! I know what you're going to do today! Track down my little Mary McGuffin.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Piece of cake. (Ferb hands him a piece of cake) Ooh, chocolate. Thanks Ferb. We'll have your little Mary McGuffin back here faster than you can say, "Hey, where's Perry?"

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, Agent P is here.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I can see that Carl, now get back in that corner until I tell you you can get up. Still fifteen minutes left on the timer.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay Sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P. we just found out that Doofenshmirtz is scouring the Tri-State Area for some sort of an on-off device.

Name: Carl
Dialog: A switch, Sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Rrrright, we think it might be a switch, but we don't know what it's for so, we need your help. Good luck Agent P.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Narrating while Ferb plays his sax) The sun beat down on the city like a hammer, a relentless hot beating hammer hammering down like a big metaphor that was... hot, for some reason.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stop with the narration and start finding my doll!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We decided to investigate at the scene of the crime. We talked to a Lawrence Fletcher, a tall gaunt looking average Joe who... (Ferb stops playing the sax, and Phineas switches back to his normal voice) Sorry.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Is that my old black and white saxophone?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We thought the investigation could use a little ambiance.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, delightful. How can I help?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We need you to tell us everything you can about the man who bought the doll.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, let me see... He had some kind of a German accent, and ooh, he was also wearing a lab coat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A lab coat, huh? Ferb? (Ferb begins to play the saxophone again) For an average Joe, he gave us an above average clue. Our next step was clear.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Who is he talking to?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, don't get me started.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Vanessa, Charitable Charities is here. Do you have your box ready?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah Mom, it's next to my bookshelf.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Oops, looks like something fell out. (She picks up the Mary McGuffin doll, and puts it in the box)

Name: Charlene
Dialog: (At the Charitable Charities man) Here you go.

Name: Man from Charitable Charities
Dialog: Aww, thanks Char. I'll pick you up at eight.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: See you then Sam.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Narrating) We figured the best place to find a man in a lab coat was at the Lab Coat Emporium. We interviewed several suspects.

Name: Suspect 1
Dialog: Well, yes I was at a garage sale, but as you can see, I don't have an accent.

Name: Suspect 2
Dialog: Yeah, I have an accent, but I have not been to a garage sale.

Name: Suspect 3
Dialog: Whoa! Hey kid, slow down. I can't answer all these questions.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well that wasn't very productive. Was it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We decided to have a talk with the owner.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Shines a bright light onto the owner of the Lab Coat Emporium) What do you know about a man in a lab coat with a German accent, frequents garage sales?

Name: Owner
Dialog: Oh, that guy, I don't know anything about that guy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright Ferb, lean on him.

Name: Owner
Dialog: Alright, alright I'll talk. Okay, there's this guy. He comes in every week for a lab coat. He has me put everything on his ex-wife's tab. See, her address is on the bill.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hm, I do see. Well thanks a lot for your help. You can wrap it up, Ferb.

Name: Owner
Dialog: Can I take this makeup off now?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I can't believe how lucky I was at that garage sale, someone's personal collection of on-off switches. Score! (Begins trying the switches on his -inator) Hmm, looks like this one doesn't fit, more where that came from. Nope. How 'bout this? Come on, Papa needs a brand new -inator. (Gets hit in the head with a rubber duck) Oh! what the--? Perry the Platypus, are you making your own keys now? Oh, you like all the stuff I got at the garage sale huh? Want to know what else I got? This lobster trap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs evilly) Yeah heh, anyway, sorry I can't tell you my evil scheme, because I... I don't know what this does yet. I'm still looking for an on-off switch. Life was much simpler when I worked as a lawn gnome.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Yes, dear?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Have you seen my little Mary McGuffin Doll?

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Could it be the one I just put in the box for Charitable Charities?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh no, Dad gave that to me.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Well, I'm sorry I didn't know. But I think the truck's still out there.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (She runs out the door, passing Phineas, Ferb and Candace as they come up.) Wait! Sam! I want to retain a portion of my mother's charitable donation!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Talking to Charlene) Excuse me, ma'am. We'd like to ask you a few questions.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Are you with the census?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, ma'am, today we're detectives.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Aren't you a little young to be detectives?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If it's all the same to you ma'am, we'll ask the questions.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: (Laughs) Oh, okay come on in. Would you kids like some apple juice?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That would be nice ma'am.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright lady, what do you know about the little Mary McGuffin doll? (takes a sip of apple juice)

Name: Charlene
Dialog: You too? Well like I told my daughter, I just gave it to charity.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And?

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Well... nothing, that's it. The Charitable Charities truck just left. They have a few locations 'round town, so I'm not sure which one they're going to.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright Ferb, pack it up. We've got some charities to visit. But I think we're going to need to update our approach.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Narrating during a montage asking Charitable Charities if they had the doll) We checked out each of the charitable charities in Danville, using every cop persona we could think of. But in every case, it seemed we had the wrong location.

Name: Charitable Charities Manager 3
Dialog: Aren't you a little young to know about all these old detective shows?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes we... (Pauses and puts on sunglasses in a Horatio Caine like fashion) ...are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, man, how many different kinds of on-off switches can there be? I mean, look-look at this. An octagon? One shaped like the Statue of Liberty? That doesn't even make sense. Oh, and here's one. The exact same size and shape that I'm looking for except it's upside-down. I mean, the words are actually printed upside-down. What kind of a dummkopf would invent an upside-down... switch...that... (Pauses, sighs, and flips the switch so that it's right-side-up.) I did it! Time to find out what this bad boy can do! (He flips the switch) On.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Not realizing what is happening) Off. On. Off. On. Off. On. Augh, I'm hearing a clanking voice, so I know it's doing something. (Realizes that the -inator opens the lobster trap) Oh, the -inator and the cage, they're connected. It's just, opens and closes the... Well I guess that's why I got the cage for free.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! I was talking! (Doofenshmirtz begins to sword battle with Perry, with a moose antler, and a marlin) Take that, and that! Hey let's see if you can take a couple of hits, from the 70's! (Begins to throw record at Perry, who avoids them, and hides behind a painting) Ahh, that takes me back... Hey where'd you go? Yow! Wh-Wh- Is that a shark's head? Are you trying to make me cry? Wait-wait-wait hold on one second here, just a second. It occurs to me that all this machine does is open and close a lobster cage so, you know it's not even evil, much less illegal. Besides, I've run out of clever fighting puns so... Curse you Perry the Platypus.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There she is! My little Mary McGuffin Doll!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Speaking to Vanessa, who was also grabbing for the doll) I'm sorry, but this is my doll.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No, it ended up here by mistake, and it's my doll.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You might think it's your doll, but it's not. I'm going to have to ask you to please let go!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You please let go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You let go!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (to Phineas) This is exactly why they took that doll off the market.

Name: Sally
Dialog: Look. She's perfect, and I just love her.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, forget it. I guess I'm too old for dolls anyway.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, maybe I don't really have to have the one object my dad spent years to find in order to show me his affection. (pause) No, actually I do. (at Sally) Give me that, kid!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (talking to Vanessa on the phone) So you just took it from the little girl and left her there crying? Wow, that is evil! Honey, I am so proud of you! It felt good didn't it? Yeah, we can build on this. (The last line of Not So Bad A Dad is reprised as episode ends.)
